entries.en: I figured we could use a soldier like her. She's been reassigned to the Normandy.
I'm the captain of this ship, Commander, and I want Williams on our crew.
Like the morning after shore leave. How long was I out?
Minor throbbing. Nothing serious. How long was I out?
How did I end up here? How long was I out?
Where's the beacon now? What happened to it?
I don't suppose it occurred to you that Eden Prime has medical facilities.
I appreciate it.
I saw-- I'm not sure what I saw. Death. Destruction. Nothing's really clear.
Williams is a good soldier. She deserves it.
I don't want her on my ship.
Not great.
I'm okay.
What about the beacon?
Not a local hospital?
More like a nightmare.
I was dreaming.
Not a dream. A vision.
That's a mistake.
I won't lie to you, Shepard. Things look bad. Nihlus is dead. The beacon was destroyed and geth are invading. The Council's going to want answers.
I'll stand behind you and your report, Shepard. You're a damned hero in my books. That's not why I'm here. It's Saren, that other turian.
Saren's a Spectre, one of the best. A living legend. But if he's working with the geth, it means he's gone rogue.
A rogue Spectre's trouble. Saren's dangerous. And he hates humans.
Jenkins wasn't your fault. You did a good job, Shepard.
The geth would have wiped out the whole colony if I hadn't stopped them.
I don't like soldiers dying under my command.
I did my job.
I feel bad about Jenkins.
Doctor? Doctor Chakwas? I think she's waking up.
Doctor? Doctor Chakwas? I think he's waking up.
Lieutenant Alenko agrees with you. That's why I added her to our crew.
How's our XO holding up, Doctor?
All the readings look normal. I'd say the commander's going to be fine.
Glad to hear it. Shepard, I need to speak with you -- in private.
Aye, aye, Captain. I'll be in the mess if you need me.
Sounds like that beacon hit you pretty hard, Commander. You sure you're okay?
Chief Williams isn't part of the Normandy crew.
Did we leave Gunnery Chief Williams back on Eden Prime?
You said you needed to see me in private, Captain?
I'll live.
Why is Williams here?
What happened to Williams?
You wanted to talk?
He thinks we're growing too fast, taking over the galaxy. A lot of aliens think that way. Most of them don't do anything about it.
But Saren has allied himself with the geth. I don't know how. I don't know why. I only know it had something to do with that beacon.
You're right. Saren has allied himself with the geth. I don't know how. I don't know why. But it had something to do with that beacon.
You were there just before the beacon self-destructed. Did you see anything? Any clue that might tell us what Saren was after?
A vision? A vision of what?
We need to report this to the Council, Shepard.
We don't know what information was stored in that beacon. Lost Prothean technology? Blueprints for some ancient weapon of mass destruction? Whatever it was, Saren took it.
But I know Saren. I know his reputation, his politics. He believes humans are a blight on the galaxy. This attack was an act of war!
He has the secrets from the beacon. He has an army of geth at his command. And he won't stop until he's wiped humanity from the face of the galaxy!
It's not that easy. He's a Spectre. He can go anywhere, do almost anything. That's why we need the Council on our side.
If we expose Saren as a traitor, the Council will revoke his Spectre status.
I'll contact the ambassador and see if he can get us an audience with the Council. He'll want to see us as soon as we reach the Citadel.
We should be getting close. Head up to the bridge and tell Joker to bring us in to dock.
He didn't come to Eden Prime because he hates humans.
Just before I lost consciousness, I had some kind of vision.
I saw synthetics. Geth, maybe. Slaughtering people. Butchering them.
They'll think I'm crazy!
What are we going to tell them? I had a bad dream?
I'll find some way to take him down.
When have they ever done anything for humanity?
We prove Saren's gone rogue and the Council will revoke his Spectre status.
What's the damage, Doctor?
Was I hurt?
Hates humans?
He wanted the beacon.
A warning.
Our death.
War.
What will we say?
There's nothing to report.
Not if I can help it!
I'll stop him.
Understood, sir!
They can't help us!
We expose him.
Don't be so hard on him, Commander. We have no idea if that's what actually set it off. Unfortunately, we'll never get the chance to find out.
Actually, we don't even know if that's what set it off. Unfortunately, we'll never get the chance to find out.
Don't be so hard on her, Commander. We have no idea if that's what actually set it off. Unfortunately, we'll never get the chance to find out.
I expect better of you, Lieutenant. You endangered the entire mission.
You had no way to know what would happen.
I expect better of my people, Williams. You endangered our entire mission.
You were careless.
The geth haven't been outside the Veil in two centuries, Commander. Nobody could have predicted this.
Intel dropped the ball, sir. We had no idea what we were walking into down there. That's why things went to hell.
I didn't do anything wrong, Captain. Hopefully, the Council can see that.
The Council can kiss my ass. I won't let them blame me for losing the beacon. I didn't do anything wrong.
I'm pissed off about the geth.
We've got nothing to hide.
To hell with them!
I've had enough of this place.
I'm ready to move on.
Yeah?
Shepard.
This place has seen better days.
Ready when you are.
Where to?
So this is where Saren's been hiding.
Those salarians were tougher than I expected.
Damn geth are everywhere.
Strange place.
I'm coming.
Saren's close. I can feel it.
We've almost got him.
Stealing an Alliance ship. Risky stuff.
But I'm right behind you, Shepard. It's the least I can do.
No sign of pursuit. That's good.
Shepard. What can I do for you?
Nice ship you've got, Shepard.
There's no story.
Go ask the quarian if you want stories.
Well, there was this one time the turians almost wiped out our entire race. That was fun.
It's not the same.
So your people were infected with a genetic mutation?
An infection that makes only a few in a thousand children survive birth?
And I suppose it's destroying your entire species?
I don't expect you to understand, but don't compare humanity's fate with the krogan.
Your ignorance doesn't upset me, Shepard.
As for the krogan, I gave up on them long ago.
The genophage infected us, but it's not what's killing us.
Ask the salarians if you want details. They made it.
Every krogan is infected. Every one. And no one's rushing to find a cure.
When was the last time you saw a krogan scientist?
It's just who we are, Shepard. I can't change that. Nobody can.
We're sure not getting any stronger.
We're too spread out. None of us are interested in staying in our own system.
But they go to colonize new worlds.
We're not settlers. We're warriors. We want to fight.
So we leave. Hire ourselves out. And most of us never go back.
What do you want, Shepard?
Lots of reasons.
Such as... I needed to get out of our system. I needed to eat. I needed to survive.
I tried to help. That's why I had to leave.
I was head of a small tribe. We were trying to restore order after the war, but the other tribes were against us.
He wanted to continue the war. He wanted us to fight: turians, salarians, each other. It didn't matter who as long as we were fighting.
I just wanted Jarrod to shut up. To stop his ranting. I wanted him to stop leading the tribes astray. But he couldn't understand how much things had changed.
We didn't have the numbers to go to war. Even if we did, the genophage made sure we couldn't replenish our numbers fast enough.
And for a while, we were getting through. Some of the tribes started coming around.
No. He didn't. He arranged a Crush with the tribes. A meeting on neutral ground. He wanted to talk.
Never a dull moment with you, Shepard.
Commander. Things got heated back on Virmire...
So long, Wrex.
What's your story, Wrex?
You krogan live for centuries. Don't tell me you haven't had a few interesting adventures.
They tried the same with us. But we fought them off.
I heard about that. You know, they almost did the same to us.
It seems similar enough to me.
I suppose it isn't all the same.
